links.comparator_used: ChatGPT responses with no specific prompt (also compared with the 'statistics and references' prompt and a fourth prompt strategy)
links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT patient education responses (Flesch-Kincaid grade level, Gunning Fog, SMOG, Fry)
links.effect: The 6th-grade-level prompt gave the most easily understandable text; responses without specific prompts were the most complex. No numeric values given in the abstract.
links.tradeoff: The 6th-grade-level prompt produced the shortest responses.
links.quote: Prompts tailored to a "6th-grade level" generated the most easily understandable text, whereas responses without specific prompts were the most complex.

design_hint: prompt strategies including reading-level constraint and reference requests
